light_description: Czech-handcrafted bass overdrive with clean blend and independent attack/grunt saturation controls.
Handcrafted hybrid fuzz combining silicon and germanium components, with clean blend, pregain, phase, mids and gate-style controls.
Tube Screamer 808-derived overdrive expanded with two-band EQ and germanium clipping.
Deluxe Germanium Overdrive state with revised cosmetics and a higher-grade op-amp while retaining the core product concept.
Hand-assembled high-gain distortion preamp derived from the Triple Wreck concept and modified with additional gain, buffering and voicing controls.
Bass overdrive derived from B85's Bass Overdrive with added tone control and refinements; documented from 2024-era listings.
Octave-up fuzz product documented in B85 Audio's catalog and Effects Database.
B85 Audio gain pedal documented in the builder's Effects Database catalog; lifetime product characterization remains a later research target.
Czech handmade fuzz inspired by the Electro-Harmonix Green Big Muff family, documented in 2022 play-test material.
